name: Perichoresis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The divine essence which contains and defines the three persons without division.

VINIT.justification: The unoriginate state before the manifestation of distinct persons.

TANCH.justification: The source and terminal anchor of the divine life that bounds the entire system.

AFWD.justification: The forward movement of the Spirit from the source toward the creation.

AREV.justification: The return of all things through the Son to the Father.

CLINK.justification: The sequential cooperation of divine wills in a single operation.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the same essence in each distinct person.

FSPLIT.justification: The distinction of the one essence into three unique relational persons.

FFUSE.justification: The mutual indwelling where the three persons reconstitute the singular divine life.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of perfect relational unity.

EVALF.justification: The impossible negative state of ontological isolation.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of divine and human natures in a single person.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible definition of the relationship.

phase_3.void_description: The apophatic darkness where no distinctions are yet named.
phase_3.true_description: The light of the divine energies manifesting the unity of the Godhead.
phase_3.false_description: The void of non-being or the heresy of tritheism.
phase_3.both_description: The mystery of the Trinity where unity and plurality exist without contradiction.

steps.domain_action: The unbegotten source exists in pre-eternal silence.
The essence identifies itself as the ground of all being.
The one essence differentiates into the relations of Father, Son, and Spirit.
The Father generates the Son in an eternal act of affirmation.
The Spirit proceeds from the Father to rest in the Son.
The persons link their operations in the act of creation.
The divine and human natures hold together in the person of the Word.
The creation returns to the source through the mediation of the Son.
The system rejects any motion toward ontological division or isolation.
The distinct persons dwell within one another to manifest the single essence.
The council fixes the definition of the relationship as an eternal truth.
The monarchy of the Father closes the cycle of divine life.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Logos who translates the divine will into cosmic order.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The Holy Spirit who mediates the communion between the persons.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Tradition which preserves the state of the divine revelation.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Kairos which determines the timing of divine interventions.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Scriptures and Liturgy which serve as the bootstrap store for the domain.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The kenotic self-emptying of the persons for the sake of the other.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The singular essence enriched by the fullness of relational communion.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The divine life is a closed loop of eternal return where nothing is lost.
